meta.name: review-claude-md
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "review CLAUDE.md", "check CLAUDE.md quality", "audit project context files", "review AGENTS.md". Review CLAUDE.md and project context files for quality, structure, and inter-file relationships.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 核查 AI 助手依赖的项目说明,让协作背景更准确
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你依赖 AI 编程助手,希望项目背景文件始终保持清晰
copy.tagline_en: Review project instruction files so your AI assistant stays on track
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you rely on AI coding assistants and want project context files to stay clear.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会审查项目里的CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md等上下文文件:读取相关文件、按评分标准打分、核实引用路径和行号是否存在,最后按reviewer格式报告问题及严重程度。
howto.when: 当用户要求“review CLAUDE.md”、“check CLAUDE.md quality”、“audit project context files”等时触发;未指定路径时审查当前工作目录。

say.note: Claude会按标准评分并列出问题

say.text: 检查项目的AGENTS.md有没有过时信息
say.note: 它会核对引用并指出失效点

say.text: 看看这份改动会不会影响CLAUDE.md里的指令？
say.note: 它会根据改动范围审查相关上下文文件

howto.what_en: Claude reviews context files like CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md: collects relevant files, scores them against a quality rubric, checks for stale or broken references, and reports findings with severity and confidence in the reviewer format.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to 'review CLAUDE.md', 'check CLAUDE.md quality', or similar. Without an argument, it reviews the current working directory.

say_en.text: Please review the quality of my CLAUDE.md
say_en.note: It scores the file and lists issues
It verifies references and flags stale content

say_en.text: Would this change break any command in CLAUDE.md?
say_en.note: It reviews context files governing the change
